warnings: Steel roof on trusses. Members from the sheet's หมายเหตุ line-type legend: แป C-75x45x15x2.3 @1.00, จันทัน C-100x50x20x2.3 @1.50, ตะเข้สัน 2C-100x50x20x2.3, ตะเข้ราง C-100x50x20x2.3, and five truss line types T1-T5 (labels T1 on rows A and B, T3 on x = 3.25, T5 on row D, T4 on x = 5.00, T2 on row E). Roofing หลังคามุงกระเบื้องลอนคู่สี (not structural, not recorded).

Trusses are split at their supports (S-04/S-05 truss elevations: T1/T5 sit on grids 1, 2, 3; T3 on T5 | T1 | T1 at D, B, A; T4 on T2 and T5; T2 on E2/E3). The T1/T5 lines run on to the roof edge at 1' / 3', which the S-03 chain prints as 1.00 eave overhangs — recorded as overhang segments with local_dimension and lower confidence (the truss elevations draw the overhang but print no length). T3, T4 and T2 overhangs are drawn but not dimensioned and are only noted.

Roof form: main gable with its ridge on x = 3.25 (T3) from A to D, hipped at the eave corners outside rows A and D (ตะเข้สัน from the eave corner to A1, A3 and D1); the carport roof (ridge T4 on x = 5.00) joins on the D side with one valley (ตะเข้ราง). Hips and the valley are diagonal, so they are recorded as counted aggregates with approximate refs, no spans (section 4: a diagonal span stays unresolved).
Unmarked members (hip, valley, rafter, purlin) have element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). Truss member sections are on the S-04/S-05 section files.
